name: liangify
description: Michael Liang's personal Claude Code customizations — agents, commands, skills, and hooks shared across projects.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Language-agnostic foundations — clean-code (Uncle Bob), code-review and git-workflow skills, and the code-tutor teaching agent.

plugins.name: typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript language style — strict typing, narrowing, discriminated unions, branded types, generics. Framework-agnostic. Depends on `core`.

plugins.name: angular
plugins.description: Angular 22 skills — zoneless + signals patterns, RxJS and resources, Signal Forms and reactive forms, Vitest testing. Depends on `core` and `typescript`.

plugins.name: unity
plugins.description: Unity 6 skills — C# scripting patterns, asset/GUID/meta hygiene for AI-assisted work, performance discipline, Test Framework + batchmode verification. Depends on `core`.

plugins.name: webgpu
plugins.description: WebGPU rendering skills — device setup and graceful failure, resource lifetime and device loss, WGSL style and uniform layout, shader/CPU geometry parity, GPU-free testing. Depends on `core` and `typescript`.

plugins.name: dicom-rt
plugins.description: DICOM and radiotherapy domain knowledge — patient coordinates and slice geometry, RTSTRUCT/RTDOSE/RTPLAN and rigid/deformable registration objects, DIMSE networking, synthetic test data rules, dose summation and EQD2 math, plus a hook that blocks DICOM files outside the synthetic test-data folder. Depends on `core`.

plugins.name: electron
plugins.description: Electron desktop skills — main/preload/renderer architecture, security hardening (isolation, sandbox, typed contextBridge, IPC validation, navigation limits, CSP, fuses), cross-platform packaging, signing, auto-update and bundled native helpers, Playwright testing. Depends on `core` and `typescript`.

plugins.name: node-service
plugins.description: TypeScript-on-Node service skills — transport-independent structure that also runs inside Electron, storage behind small interfaces (SQLite/PostgreSQL, streaming), long-running job contract for native workers, auth/audit/PHI-safe logging, Vitest and container-based integration tests. Framework-agnostic. Depends on `core` and `typescript`.

plugins.name: cpp-itk
plugins.description: Native compute skills — modern C++ style and static analysis, target-based CMake with presets and pinned ITK/elastix across macOS/Windows/Linux, ITK pipelines and transform conventions vs DICOM registration objects, a command-line worker contract for Node job runners, native unit/regression testing. Depends on `core`.
